news.headline: Tulane linebacker makes national comeback list
news.summary: Dickson Agu hurt his knee in September and missed the rest of last season. He is now one of 94 players named to the watch list for college football's Comeback Player of the Year award.

news.headline: Four quarterbacks still fighting for the job
news.summary: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion ran for two touchdowns in the first fall scrimmage and the offense gave the ball away only once. Coach Will Hall names his first depth chart on August 24.

news.headline: Defense dominates in first fall scrimmage
news.summary: Tulane's defense set the tone early in Saturday's first scrimmage, and coach Will Hall said the offense answered back in the red zone. The four-way quarterback race stays open with the season opener three weeks away.

news.headline: LJ McCray up for national comeback award
news.summary: McCray broke his foot early last year and played only four snaps all season. He is back healthy and on the watch list for college football's Comeback Player of the Year award.

news.headline: Florida left out of preseason AP Top 25
news.summary: The Gators didn't crack the AP's preseason poll, though they had the second-most votes among unranked teams. It's a fresh-start season under new coach Jon Sumrall, so this is the low point expectations can only rise from.

news.headline: QB battle still even after first scrimmage
news.summary: Neither Aaron Philo nor Tramell Jones Jr. has separated himself in fall camp, coach Jon Sumrall said after Florida's first scrimmage. The competition is expected to continue right up until the season opener.

news.headline: Linebacker Ty'Anthony Smith leaves Texas
news.summary: Junior linebacker Ty'Anthony Smith is no longer with the Longhorns. Texas loses a veteran at that spot two weeks before its first game.

news.headline: Arch Manning named to Golden Arm Award watch list
news.summary: For the second year in a row, Texas quarterback Arch Manning made the watch list for the nation's top upperclassman quarterback. It comes as No. 5 Texas looks to bounce back from last year's two early losses and get back into the College Football Playoff.

news.headline: Goosby could return by season opener
news.summary: Doctors say Trevor Goosby's knee bruise should heal in two to three weeks. That could have him back for the September 5 opener, and he should be ready by the Ohio State game on September 12 at the latest.

news.headline: NFL fines Saints $500,000 for practice fights
news.summary: The Saints and Cowboys were each fined after multiple fights broke out during their joint practice in Oxnard on Tuesday. It is one of the largest fines the NFL has issued for a joint practice.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara out at least a month with knee sprain
news.summary: Kamara sprained the MCL in his knee during Tuesday's joint practice with the Cowboys and is expected to miss at least a month. It's a tough blow to the Saints' offense heading into the season.

news.headline: Rookie receiver Jordyn Tyson out 8 weeks
news.summary: First-round pick Jordyn Tyson strained his hamstring and is expected to miss about eight weeks. Coach Kellen Moore says this injury is not related to his past hamstring problems.

news.headline: Yankees beat Blue Jays for fifth win in a row
news.summary: Rookie Spencer Jones hit a two-run home run in the second inning and New York won 3-1 on Friday night. The Yankees are now three games behind Tampa Bay in the American League East.

news.headline: Gerrit Cole passes Clemens on Yankees K list
news.summary: Cole struck out eight in New York's 6-1 win over Baltimore, moving past Roger Clemens for 12th on the Yankees' all-time strikeout list. It capped a series sweep and the team's fourth straight win.

news.headline: Aaron Judge nearing his return
news.summary: Judge started hitting off a tee and doing soft toss this week as he recovers from his rib injury. Most reports point to him coming back sometime in September.
